# FDN Chart a Course
# "Draw two cards." is the compiler's (B5a-draw-two). "Then discard a card unless you attacked this
# turn.": the trailing "unless" frame, `parse "Draw a card unless you attacked this turn."`
# (B13-if: Conditional(FNot(<attacked>), ...)), around the discard step of "Draw three cards, then
# discard a card." (Rain of Revelation, B5a-draw-three-then-discard); "Then" is the Seq order.
spell = SpellAbility(
    kind=SpellKind.SORCERY,
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=2), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
            Conditional(
                pred=FNot(
                    inner=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TURN_OF, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                            FAtom(
                                pred=FAtomPred.EVENT_THIS_TURN,
                                count=QConst(value=1),
                                event=DeclareAttackersEvent(filter=FAnd(children=())),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                then_effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                    'cards': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=FAnd(children=()),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
                    ),
                    'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
                    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
                    'from': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
                }),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [spell]

clauses.clause: Then discard a card unless you attacked this turn.

mapping.notes: Draw two is the compiler's; 'Then discard a card unless you attacked this turn.' is the trailing-unless frame (parse 'Draw a card unless you attacked this turn.': Conditional(FNot(TURN_OF YOU and EVENT_THIS_TURN DeclareAttackersEvent))) around Rain of Revelation's discard step. ENGINE (weaker than printed): a sorcery cannot be cast after combat: legality.spell_window_reason allows sorcery-speed casts only in phase None/FIRST_MAIN (SECOND_MAIN -> window:phase) and games.py has no post-combat act batch, so 'you attacked this turn' is never true when Chart a Course resolves and it always discards. A pack casting it after a combat step raises 'illegal cast: window:phase'.
